featured_reviews.name: Kalyani K
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered 2 kg Mango cake for my son's birthday.  Artificial colouring made it look very cheap. Forget real mangoes, not even Mango pulp was used. Cake had absolutely no taste of Mango. Waste of money. Do not recommend at all. I am always for promoting small businesses but felt cheated. You can see the supposedly Mango cake in the images. Not sure about the other reviews if given by relatives and friends.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for yours kind words😇.मला तर गरज होतीच अशा एका customer ची.बाकी तू कितीही negativity पसरवण्याचा विचार केलास तर तुला ते शक्य होणार नाही.राहिली गोष्ट मैंगो केक ची तर.mango cake ची ऑर्डर दिली असताना मी तुम्हाला दुसरा कुठला फ्लेवर का म्हणून सर्व्ह करेन.आणि रिलेटिव्ह आणि frds ने भले रिव्यु ऐड केले असतील तरी इतकं खोट या जगात कोणालाच बोलता येत नाही.तू केक खाल्लच नसतास तर गोष्ट वेगळी होती.शॉप मधून घेतलेला शिळा केक तुम्हाला चालतो कारण पैसे दिलेले असतात म्हनून खाता.इथं रिफंड साठी काय काय कारण काढून दीदी शी बोलणं झाल ते मला सगळं माहीत आहे.बाकी स्मॉल business ला इतका सपोर्ट केलात म्हणून मी तुमची आभारी आहे.आणि कलर फ़ूड कलर शिवाय दुसरा कुठलाच कलर use केला जात नाही.thank you and sorry.🙌🏻🙏
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_translated_text: Thank you so much for your kind words😇. I really needed such a customer. No matter how much negativity you think of spreading, you will not be able to do it. The remaining thing is about mango cake. When you ordered mango cake, why would I serve you any other flavor? And even if relatives and friends have added reviews, no one in this world can tell such a lie. If you had not eaten the cake, the story would have been different. You eat stale cake bought from the shop because you have paid for it. I know everything about what excuses you have to talk to Didi for a refund. I am grateful to you for supporting small businesses so much. And no other color is used except food color. Thank you and sorry. 🙌🏻🙏

featured_reviews.review_text: I've ordered from Ulka's a few times for myself and for friends, and I’m honestly impressed. The cookies had the perfect crumb texture! featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered from ULKA – Handcrafted Cookies & More, and I’m genuinely so impressed! The cookies were fresh, soft, and perfectly baked — not overly sweet, just the right balance. You can truly taste the quality and care in every bite.

What really touched my heart was the handwritten note wishing me Happy Holi. It’s such a small gesture, but it made the whole experience feel personal and special.

It’s rare to find home-based bakeries that deliver both amazing taste and warmth. Highly recommend supporting this lovely small business. I’ll definitely be ordering again!

Best it is very economical also

featured_reviews.review_text:
I first tasted these cookies years ago when Durvankur was just starting out and they’ve only gotten sweeter over the years. The taste is top-notch and all the flavors are 🤌

If you’re craving something homemade with love and warmth, you’re in the right place 😋

featured_reviews.name: Rama Bhide
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ulka and Durvankur bake the best handcrafted cookies and brownies. Their signature date and walnut cake is just out of this world!

Their cookies are perfectly gooey and chewy, the brownie - rich and beautifully balanced, and the date and walnut cake is soft and full of warm, comforting flavour.

The taste is so good it reminds you of childhood days. No wonder everything gets sold out so quickly!

Best wishes to Ulka and Durvankur for baking each item so thoughtfully and making it so flavourful. With taste like this, you are bound to become famous.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for the kind words and the appreciation. To remind someone of their childhood is probably the best compliment that we have received.

I personally loved their chocolate and coffee cookie the most!

Go try out guys, homemade and fresh always!😁
